external.title: Other calendars
external.description: Follow Google Calendar, Outlook or any other calendar, import an .ics file, or share OpenFamily's.
external.followDescription: Their events appear in the calendar and are refreshed every 30 minutes.
external.whereTitle: Where do I find this address?
external.whereGoogle: Google Calendar (on a computer): Settings, pick the calendar, then “Integrate calendar” and copy “Secret address in iCal format”.
external.whereOutlook: Outlook.com: Settings, Calendar, Shared calendars, “Publish a calendar”, then copy the ICS link.
external.whereApple: Apple Calendar (iCloud): share the calendar as a “Public Calendar” and copy the webcal:// link.
external.whereOther: Elsewhere (school, club, Proton…): look for an “iCal”, “ICS” or “webcal” link.
external.privacy: This address gives access to the calendar: OpenFamily keeps it encrypted and never shows it again after adding.
external.namePlaceholder: The calendar's own name if empty
external.refreshNote: Events from the past year and the year ahead are copied. They are edited in the original calendar.
external.confirmRemove: Stop following “{{name}}”? Its events will be removed from the calendar.
external.importDescription: A one-off copy you can edit here. Importing the same file again updates instead of duplicating.
external.importDone: {{created}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} already up to date.
external.importTruncated: The file had more than 5,000 events: only the first ones were copied.
external.readOnlyNotice: This event comes from “{{name}}”. Edit it in the original calendar. Here you can choose who it concerns, reminders and notes.
